That's what you get for picking up young ones to help you fly that rusty clunker you call a star freighter.''"<br />"''She's fast. Never better.''"<br />"''Who d'ya mean? The ship or the girl? The '''''Seventy-Seven Stars''''' was a [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] [[Captain/Legends|captained]] by the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[To'iir]] and co-[[Pilot/Legends|piloted]] by his apprentice, [[Liadden]].

==History==
In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], the ''Seventy-Seven Stars'' was present at the [[Kothlis shadowport]] when a [[Super Star Destroyer/Legends|''Super''-class Star Destroyer]] ventured into nearby space, resulting in the [[Shadowport/Legends|shadowport's]] evacuation.
